rachel-sales: Quick sync - Kepler Bank wants a short POC. Requirements: streaming (WS primary, SSE fallback), function/tool calls with structured JSON output, on-prem connector (VPC), SAML SSO, and offline KMS/HSM. They asked for a one-page checklist + a rough cost ballpark for 250 qps steady, spikes to 1k.

 tom-eng: Acknowledged. Which client SDKs? They mentioned Go edge proxy + Python orchestration.

 rachel-sales: Correct. Edge in Go; backend Python. Edge must use ephemeral creds behind corp proxies.

 anya-ml: Streaming rec: WebSocket for low latency, SSE fallback for proxies. We can stream partial tool call frames so UI can show incremental function args/results. Example stream line: `{"evt":"tool.part","id":"tc-9","payload":{"name":"lookup","partial":"{\"id\":\"...\"}"}}`.

 tom-eng: Ephemeral token header (Go): `req.Header.Set("Authorization", fmt.Sprintf("Bearer %s", token))` rotate ~5m. If they run on-prem, recommend site-to-site VPN or VPC peering for allowlist constraints.

 sec-bot: Note: Dedicated pool recommended if sustained >500 qps. Hosted can cover bursts but cost is higher. See /pricing/dedicated-estimator.

 rachel-sales: For the email - need allowlist IPs, SAML metadata steps, ephemeral token snippet, dedicated estimator link, and security contact. Also note GPU lead time if Dedicated.

 tom-eng: I'll drop allowlist IP ranges and Go snippet + minimal runbook by EOD.

 anya-ml: I'll share structured-output schema example and a tiny eval prompt set to validate tool-call shape. Also SOC2 summary for the security questionnaire.

 rachel-sales: Thanks team. Target POC start in 2 weeks pending SAML and network. :calendar: :thumbsup:

 [thread end]
